//: GO-LIVE CHECKLIST for the identity server. Not used on your machine: setup reads user-secrets.template.json. Every <GO-LIVE ...> value must be replaced before launch. SECRET values go in Key Vault; the rest are container settings (Terraform). Nested keys become environment variables with __, e.g. Email__SendGrid__ApiKey. Values without <...> are what live should use. The app refuses to start outside Development with the Development age-check providers or without DataProtection:KeyVaultKeyId.

ConnectionStrings.IdentityDatabase: <GO-LIVE: Azure SQL with the app's managed identity, e.g. Server=tcp:<server>.database.windows.net,1433;Database=idsrv;Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity;Encrypt=True>
ConnectionStrings.Messaging: <GO-LIVE: the badjockeys database, with a login that can only read messaging.subscriptions and add rows to the messaging tables; Encrypt=True>

Duende.LicenseKey: <GO-LIVE SECRET: Duende IdentityServer licence key (apply for the free Community Edition before launch)>

DataProtection.//: Required outside Development. The app's managed identity needs get, wrap and unwrap on the key.
DataProtection.ManagedIdentityClientId: <GO-LIVE (only for a user-assigned identity): its client id; otherwise empty>

Email.//: Confirmation, password reset and sign-in code emails. Provider defaults to Log, which sends NOTHING: live must say SendGrid.
Email.FromAddress: <GO-LIVE: e.g. no-reply@badjockeys.com, on a domain verified in SendGrid>
Email.LogoUrl: <GO-LIVE: a PNG logo for email headers, e.g. https://badjockeys.com/email-logo.png>
Email.PublicOrigin: <GO-LIVE: this server's public address, e.g. https://auth.badjockeys.com>

SendGrid.ApiKey: <GO-LIVE SECRET: SendGrid API key with the Mail Send permission only>

Web.Secret: <GO-LIVE SECRET: a long random string; the web app's IDSRV_CLIENT_SECRET>

Authentication.//: Social sign-in: each is switched on only when its keys are set. Leave a provider's keys empty to keep it off.

SignUp.//: Cloudflare adds the visitor's country; trust it only behind Cloudflare.

AgeAssurance.//: The on-demand age check for sensitive posts. The Development providers are refused outside Development. NOTE: there's no real photo-ID provider yet; one has to be chosen and integrated (an IDocumentAgeCheck) before launch.

Http.Name: <GO-LIVE: the age estimation vendor, e.g. Yoti>

BootstrapEmails: <GO-LIVE: the first admin's confirmed email, e.g. aaron.greenhalgh@badjockey.com>
